description: A round from AI PM Lab's challenges, built from real recorded runs: Call It (predict what a model did), Spot the Failure (ship or flag a real output) or Which Wins? (pick the better of two setups). Returns the question without its answer; call again with the round id and the user's choice to mark it, see how players on the site called it, and get the next round.

answer.description: The user's choice for that round: its letter

game.description: call-it, spot-the-failure or which-wins; any if left out

round.description: The id of the round the user is answering, from the last quiz_me result

name: quiz_me

links.description: The AI PM Lab pages the answer links to, where each idea can be tried hands-on

text.description: The answer in markdown, as shown to the user; for the guides, instructions to follow with the user's text

title: Quiz me on real AI results
